column1: # Other countries' cities, from an independent solar calculation (NOAA/Meeus series, not the app's own formula) with the country's parameters; the app must agree within a minute. name, date, lat, lon, zone, then fajr sunrise dhuhr asr maghrib isha, then the UTC offset in minutes the times are written at (local noon; where a machine's time-zone data has another, the tests re-base the row by the difference and say so). Casablanca and Marrakesh are written at +01, Morocco's clock outside Ramadan before tzdata 2026c (UTC+0 from 20 September 2026 since). Not an official timetable.
